label: UCM6304 IP PBX
description: Grandstream UCM6304 unified communications PBX, Asterisk 16 based, for up to 2000 users and 300 concurrent calls with 4 FXS and 4 FXO ports. Three self-adaptive Gigabit RJ45 ports that can run switched, routed or dual mode, with a NAT router and firewall; 12 V DC powered, no PoE input.
notes: 'Three self-adaptive Gigabit ports (switched, routed or dual mode) with PoE+ and NAT router' - in switched mode the three ports behave as an L2 switch (hence l2-forward), in routed mode as a NAT/firewall edge (nat, l3-forward). Grandstream's 'PoE+' wording refers to the UCM6300 family's power-source capability, but no per-port PSE budget is published, so no poeOut is modelled on these ports. Power: 2 x DC 12 V jacks, 100-240 V AC adapter. Hot-standby HA, GDMS cloud management, UCM RemoteConnect NAT traversal. 4 FXS + 4 FXO RJ11 ports and the USB/SD ports are not modelled.
